deadline.value: Applications are accepted at any time, but advertised projects have their own deadlines and close early once filled.
deadline.quote: you can submit your application at any time throughout the year

also.quote: there are individual deadlines for announced projects

toefl_min.value: Accepted proof of English is TOEFL iBT 90 (or 4.5 on the new 6-point scale).
toefl_min.quote: Test of English as a Foreign Language (TOEFL) with at least 90 TOEFL-test points (out of 120)

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall is accepted as proof of English.
ielts_min.quote: International English Language Test System (IELTS) with a result of at least 6.5 (out of 9)

english_waiver.value: Applicants whose undergraduate program was taught in English are asked to provide a suitable certificate from their faculty; a plain exemption is not stated.
english_waiver.quote: Applicants who took part in an undergraduate program in which the language of instruction was English are asked to provide a suitable certificate from their Faculty.

also.quote: Applicants who are exempted from providing proof of language proficiency are requested to upload the statement of exemption

funding.value: PhD positions are usually paid on the TV-L E13 salary scale at 50 to 65 percent.
funding.quote: PhD positions are usually renumerated according to TV-L E13 (50 - 65%)

entry_route.value: Not stated on the pages checked

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field: ETS discontinued the GRE Biology Test in May 2021.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Biology Test and the GRE Literature in English Test were discontinued in May 2021.

supervisor.value: Not stated on the pages checked

notes: Admission also requires acceptance by the Faculty of Biosciences. Applicants with medical degrees cannot join HBIGS.
